architecture.mechanism: Dual-estimator structure combining Coulomb counting, open-circuit voltage correction, and an extended Kalman filter to enhance steady-state accuracy of state-of-charge estimation under thermal variations
architecture.intervention: Integrate a dual-estimator battery management algorithm into the vehicle electrical system that continuously applies Coulomb counting with OCV correction and EKF processing during storage to accurately track true state-of-charge and trigger preemptive low-power preservation modes before voltage drops below the control module memory retention threshold
architecture.expected_effect: The battery retains sufficient charge during garage storage by preventing unrecognized deep discharge, preserving control module memory, and enabling immediate vehicle operation without requiring jump-starts
architecture.falsification_test: Park the vehicle in a garage for 30 days with the dual-estimator active, log the estimated versus actual state-of-charge daily, and attempt engine start and gear engagement at the end of the period; failure occurs if measured battery voltage falls below 12.0V or if any control module loses stored memory parameters
